item.title: On Monday in Oil and Gas, Federal Hormuz Data Lands as Two Acquisitions Are Announced

item.content:encoded:
News / PR Newswire / On Monday in Oil and Gas, Federal Hormuz Data Lands as Two Acquisitions Are Announced

On Monday in Oil and Gas, Federal Hormuz Data Lands as Two Acquisitions Are Announced 7 min read

XOM TRP TRP CNQ HOUSTON, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oil Market Daily News Commentary  - Oil prices fell on Monday, Reuters reported, citing signs that oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz are recovering, which it said reinforced expectations of surplus supply. The same day, the U.S. Energy Information Administration published new quarterly figures on oil moving through the strait, a tanker transiting it outbound reported being struck, and two North American producers announced acquisitions. The December NYMEX West Texas Intermediate contract settled at $88.56 a barrel on Friday, Nov. 13, according to CME Group, which had not posted official settlements for Monday when this article was prepared. Active Companies from around the markets with current developments this week include: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation ( XOM ) , TC Energy Corporation ( TRP ) ( TRP ) , Canadian Natural Resources Limited ( CNQ ) ( CNQ ) , Diamondback Energy, Inc. ( FANG ) , and Weatherford International Corp ( WFRD ) . New federal numbers on the strait The EIA's Global Energy Security Data, released Monday, put total oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz at 9.1 million barrels per day in the third quarter of 2026. That compares with 5.1 million barrels per day in the second quarter of 2026 and 21.4 million barrels per day in the third quarter of 2025. Of the third-quarter 2026 total, crude oil and condensate accounted for 7.3 million barrels per day and petroleum products for 1.8 million barrels per day. The agency noted that since the end of February 2026, AIS signal data for ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz have become especially unreliable, and that 2026 Hormuz tanker tracking data are being revised frequently. Shipping reports from the region UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said in incident report #207, dated Nov. 16, that in an incident in the Strait of Hormuz, the Company Security Officer of a tanker reported the vessel being struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound. UKMTO said this resulted in a fire in the engine room, that no casualties have been reported and all crew have been accounted for, and that damage assessment and environmental impact were unknown at the time of the report. Separately, Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Monday that two oil tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Reuters, which said it could not independently verify the report. Reuters also reported that the International Energy Agency said on Friday the world oil market will return to a surplus in the fourth quarter of this year, with oil supply averaging 105 million barrels per day in the quarter, 1.7 million barrels per day higher than forecast demand. Supply from Guyana and pipe in Alberta A news release posted Monday by ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation ( XOM ) said ExxonMobil Guyana announced startup of production at Uaru, the fifth development in Guyana's offshore Stabroek block, raising Guyana's installed production capacity to 1.1 million barrels per day. The release said the Errea Wittu vessel is expected to achieve its initial production capacity of 250,000 barrels per day in the first quarter of 2027. "The startup of Errea Wittu is another major milestone for Guyana and ExxonMobil," said ExxonMobil Upstream Company President Dan Ammann. "In just over a decade, Guyana has become one of the world's fastest-growing and most important new sources of energy supply." TC Energy Corporation ( TRP ) ( TRP ) on Monday shared its next phase of growth on its NGTL System, including plans for the proposed Alberta Growth Connector, an approximately 370-kilometre, 48-inch, west-to-east natural gas pipeline that would connect Western Canadian natural gas supply to Alberta's oil sands region via NGTL. The company said its 2026 NGTL System Annual Plan, which is subject to finalization, forecasts total demand on the system will increase approximately 25 per cent, from 14.4 billion cubic feet per day in 2026 to approximately 18 billion cubic feet per day in 2031. The proposed connector and related facilities remain subject to securing commercial support, engagement with rightsholders and stakeholders, regulatory approvals and TC Energy's project-sanctioning process. "Growing natural gas demand across Alberta reinforces NGTL's role as a foundational part of TC Energy's business and a core platform for future growth," said François Poirier, TC Energy's President and Chief Executive Officer. Oil Market Daily's sister site, Stock Preachers, offers a free 27-page guide, Knowledge is Power , with 10 chapters in plain English on the two skills every trade comes down to: reading the news and reading the chart. Readers who sign up also receive The Roadmap every Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Two acquisitions in two basins Canadian Natural Resources Limited ( CNQ ) ( CNQ ) announced Monday that it has entered into a definitive arrangement agreement with Advantage Energy Ltd. relating to the acquisition of all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Advantage for cash. The company said the acquisition includes production of approximately 79,000 BOE/d of Montney and Charlie Lake assets. The transaction is targeted to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the satisfaction of conditions typical for a transaction of this nature. Canadian Natural's President, Scott Stauth, stated, "Advantage Energy is an excellent strategic fit for Canadian Natural. The acquisition builds on our significant Montney and Charlie Lake positions and provides additional synergies of scale to further improve on area efficiencies." Diamondback Energy, Inc. ( FANG ) said Monday it has entered into a definitive purchase agreement to acquire certain subsidiaries of Double Eagle IV Midco, LLC and Double Eagle V Midco, LLC in exchange for approximately 15.56 million shares of Diamondback common stock and $2.15 billion of cash, subject to customary adjustments. The company listed approximately 176,000 net acres in the core of the Midland Basin and estimated 2027 oil production of approximately 35 MBo/d (92 MBoe/d, 38% oil). Diamondback said it expects the transaction to close on December 21, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. "This acquisition is another important step in Diamondback's continued growth within the Midland Basin," stated Kaes Van't Hof, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Diamondback. Offshore services Weatherford International Corp ( WFRD ), which announced on Nov. 13 that it had completed its redomestication from Ireland to Delaware, said Monday it has been awarded a contract by Constellation to provide deepwater managed pressure drilling (MPD) solutions for an exploration campaign. The award comprises an initial 12-month rental period for Weatherford's deepwater MPD technology and equipment, the sale of an MPD system to be delivered within 12 months and a two-year aftermarket contract, and builds on Weatherford's May 2026 managed pressure drilling award with Constellation in Brazil. The release did not disclose a contract value. Girish Saligram, Weatherford's President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, "Brazil is a key growth market for Weatherford, and this award with Constellation strengthens our position as the leading MPD provider in the country while opening a multi-year pathway of equipment, systems and aftermarket services as the exploratory campaign held by the Amaralina Star (UDW Drillship) advances." The calendar from here Seven OPEC+ countries, including Saudi Arabia and Russia, decided at a Nov. 1 meeting to maintain September 2026 required production for December 2026, according to an OPEC press release, and said their next meeting will be held on Nov. 29, 2026. The EIA's next Short-Term Energy Outlook is scheduled for release on Dec. 8, 2026. The RUNE token in THORChain is used as collateral for validators in the network and to ensure liquidity in the liquidity pools.

Coin98 added Arbitrum support to Private Mode on November 16th. The integration enabled private token swaps and transfers on the network. Refer to the official tweet by C98:

Coin98 Super Wallet @coin98_wallet

. @arbitrum has the speed. The scale. The security. Now it has privacy too on Coin98 👻 Coin98 Private Mode now supports Arbitrum. Swap. Send. With Privacy. On Coin98. Powered by @HoudiniSwap pic.twitter.com/g9XyymPBYT

Nov 16, 2026

C98 Info Coin98 is an all-in-one DeFi platform that aims to fulfill untapped demand in the industry and become a gateway bridging TradFi users to any DeFi services on multiple blockchains. It accomplishes this mission through a full suite of products, including Coin98 Wallet, Coin98 Exchange, and Space Gate (cross-chain bridge). Coin98 Wallet: Allows users to store, send, receive, manage crypto assets and connect to numerous dApps on multiple blockchains. It supports over 20 blockchains such as Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, Solana, Polygon, Avalanche, Terra, etc on both mobile (iOS & android) and Chrome extension versions. Coin98 Exchange: A multichain liquidity aggregator that allows users to swap, stake, lend, borrow, earn crypto with the best rates and low slippage. Space Gate: A cross-chain bridge that enables swapping and transferring values across multiple networks. It supports token swaps between ERC-20 tokens, BEP20 tokens, SPL tokens, and more. The C98 token is the native utility token of the Coin98 platform and will be used to pay services fees, as staking incentives, for governance, and unique membership rights.
